function.description: Get full details for ONE known prediction market by ID — YES/NO buy/sell prices, volume, status, payout. Use solana.predict.events/.search first to find a marketId, or solana.predict.orderbook for order-book depth beyond the top-of-book prices returned here. Price fields (buyYesPriceUsd, buyNoPriceUsd, sellYesPriceUsd, sellNoPriceUsd) are exact-decimal USD strings with raw *Micro siblings; volumeUsd is a whole-dollar exact string.
function.name: solana__predict_market_get

marketId.description: Market ID (from solana.predict.events, solana.predict.search, or an event's nested markets).
